source: hawse-research/kalshi-15m-payout-sweep.md section 7 (H2: YES favorite, 93-98c, 6-10 minutes left, paper only), recorder per kalshi-15m-study.md section 7A

rule.entry: first observed book with secondsLeft in [360, 600] and YES ask in [0.93, 0.979]; one entry per market; no other filters

coverage.why: a first touch is only trusted if books were observed continuously from before 600 s left until the signal; otherwise the market is logged as a skip (joined_late / incomplete_coverage), never as a signal

fill.model: take the ask on the NEXT book snapshot after the signal (no same-snapshot fills)
fill.price: worse (higher) of the signal ask and the VWAP to fill 1 contract on the next snapshot
fill.specLiteralShadow: P&L at the signal ask is also logged as a sensitivity column; it is not the headline number

fees.oneLot: ceil(0.07 * P * (1 - P) * 100) / 100 dollars per 1-contract order (Kalshi general fee, cent-rounded up)
fees.largeOrder: 0.07 * P * (1 - P) dollars per contract (rounding amortized)

settlement.source: official Kalshi market result (GET /markets/{ticker}: result yes/no once status is determined/settled/finalized)
